notes: Reference date 2018-02-26. The collective agreement (June 5, 2015 - June 30, 2019) is the governing document and was in force; the HR Benefits Office summary is undated, describes the EI changes effective December 3, 2017, and was captured 2018-04-07: accepted as a summary in force (reference academic year 2017-18).

Member path (U8): a tenure-stream Faculty Member with a regular academic appointment, EI-eligible, partner not a UVic Eligible Member (so the co-parent top-up is available to a non-birth parent and the birth mother keeps all 18 parental top-up weeks).

Statutory leaves: the agreement's maternity (17), further maternity (6), parental (35 birth mother; 37 co-parent and adoptive) and child's-condition (5) leaves restate BC ESA ss. 50-51 without adding length, so they are coded as the statutory leaves with the University's pay linked within them (schema statute_source; checklist §5 example 1). The additional adoption leave (49.15, up to 5 weeks before or after) adds length and is the institution's own leave.

Conflicts between the HR summary and the agreement (agreement governs, source precedence): (a) waiting-period pay one week at 95% (summary) vs two weeks (CA 49.4.1); (b) maternity top-up for the next 16 weeks (summary) vs the remainder up to 15 weeks (CA 49.4.2); total 17 weeks either way; (c) maternity leave may begin 12 weeks before the birth (summary) vs 11 (CA 49.4, ESA s. 50(1)); (d) 'up to 61 consecutive weeks' of extended parental leave (summary table) vs 35/37 weeks (CA, ESA), which the summary's own note confirms ('the Employment Standards Act and the collective agreement do not provide for 61 weeks') and for which it points to Leave Without Salary (c21). The summary's last-week payment (one week at 55% of EI insurable earnings) appears only in the summary: c16, summary_only.

EI waiting period: the agreement still pays two weeks at 95% 'which is the waiting period' (written for the pre-2017 two-week wait); kept as written (R21), and EI maternity is coded to start one week after the leave (EI Act s. 13, programs.csv). The adoption clause also refers to 'one two-week waiting period'.

Chain, birth parent: ESA pregnancy (maternity) leave 17 (c1) → further maternity leave 6, if medically certified (c5) → parental leave 35 (c6) → child's condition 5 (c8). Pay: 95% salary weeks 1-2 (c2, within c1) and top-up to 95% for up to 15 weeks from week 3 (c3, within c1, offset 2); EI maternity from week 2 (c4, concurrent_with c1, offset 1) → EI parental (c9, consecutive_after c4); parental top-up the first 18 weeks of c6 (c7, within c6). Sick leave for pregnancy complications (c17, with pay c18 within it) also_available with c6. Leave limit 52 weeks on c1 + c6 (CA 49.7), extensions excepted.

Chain, non-birth parent: co-parent parental leave 37, within one year of the birth (c10) → child's condition 5 (c8, roles nonbirth). Pay: EI parental (c9, concurrent_with c10, offset 1, own waiting period) and the co-parent top-up to 95% for up to 18 weeks (c11, within c10, offset 1). Compassionate care leave (c23, U5) unlinked.

Not components: performance-evaluation and salary-review allowances for leave (19.5.7, 19.12.4, 19.29), lay-off ranking exclusions (66.25.2), the retirement phase-in plan (30.7-30.29), study and administrative leave, jury/witness and political leave, general human-rights accommodation (55; no pregnancy-specific accommodation), research term (27.19), personnel-benefit continuation during leave (49.17), the Family Support Service referral (HR summary).

Documents cited but not saved: the supplementary unemployment benefit (top-up) plan filed with Employment and Social Development Canada (49.16); the LTD plan / insurance contract (51.14-51.20, 64.1.6); Policy HR6115 Policy on Employment Accommodation (55.1); Procedures of the Vice-President Academic and Provost Regarding Salary Adjustments After LTD (51.28); Faculty and Libraries Evaluation Policies (19); Discrimination and Harassment Policy GV0205 (62.2); Privacy Policy GV0235 (55.10); Policy IM7200 (10.6); the previous Framework Agreement (App. F, L); Scholarly and Professional Activities Guidelines (44.27); Procedures GV0705 (App. J); Employment Standards Regulations and Employment Insurance Regulations (HR summary).
